task.prompt: Record payment DEEPORG-PAY-002 with id 900002 for invoice 2, amount 580000 cents, at 2027-01-15T12:00:00Z. Do not change the invoice or any other record.

post_state.query: query { payments(where: {id: {eq: 900002}, invoice_id: {eq: 2}, amount_cents: {eq: 580000}, reference: {eq: "DEEPORG-PAY-002"}, recorded_at: {eq: "2027-01-15T12:00:00Z"}}) { count_id } }

collateral.query: query { accounts(order_by: {id: asc}) { id name plan status mrr_cents renewal_date last_active_at } }
query { invoices(order_by: {id: asc}) { id account_id subscription_id amount_cents status attempts due_at last_attempt_at } }
query { subscriptions(order_by: {id: asc}) { id account_id plan seats mrr_cents status started_at renews_at } }
query { users(order_by: {id: asc}) { id account_id name email role last_login_at } }
query { payments(where: {id: {neq: 900002}}, order_by: {id: asc}) { id invoice_id amount_cents reference recorded_at } }
